_finding: On Base, 12.11.2026, DexScreener listed pools from one Aerodrome factory as tens of thousands of dollars deep while each held about $0.01 of USDC, and for 14 of the 41 Base tokens with an eligible pool the premium was read from one of them. The recorder now reads every pool it knows from the chain at one block, and the chain wins. These mutations put the aggregator back in charge, turn a pool round, and drop the bytes that make the evidence re-checkable.

mutations.name: the aggregator keeps its liquidity where the chain read the pool
mutations.find: liquidity: { ...(p.liquidity || {}), usd: r.liquidityUsd != null ? r.liquidityUsd : p?.liquidity?.usd }
mutations.expect: FAIL the chain's liquidity replaces the aggregator's

mutations.name: a pool whose token1 is ours is not inverted
mutations.find:
const inOther = tIs0 ? p : 1 / p
    const bT
mutations.expect: FAIL token1 is ours: the price inverts

mutations.name: a v4 pool against WETH is read anyway
mutations.expect: FAIL a v4 pool against WETH is not read

mutations.name: the evidence leaves out the WETH/USD leg
mutations.expect: FAIL the evidence calldata is exactly the pool's calls and the WETH/USD leg

mutations.name: the result bytes are encoded with a wrong head
mutations.expect: FAIL one result is laid out as the ABI says

mutations.name: a pool values its own token side at its own price
mutations.find: depth(human(bT, dT), human(bO, dO) * usdO, ctx.tokenUsd)
mutations.replace: depth(human(bT, dT), human(bO, dO) * usdO, priceUsd)
mutations.expect: FAIL a pool does not set its own depth: dust at an absurd price is dust

mutations.name: with no issuer price the token side is valued at the pool price
mutations.find: const depth = (tokens, otherUsd, tokenUsd) => otherUsd + (tokenUsd > 0 ? tokens * tokenUsd : 0)
mutations.replace: const depth = (tokens, otherUsd, tokenUsd) => otherUsd + tokens * (tokenUsd > 0 ? tokenUsd : 250)
mutations.expect: FAIL with no issuer price only the stablecoin or WETH side counts
